lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in distinct horizontal rows along the mid-lateral line posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical columns of circular spots, forming a coordinate-like grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two dominant longitudinal ridges characterized by a high-intensity upper specular highlight and a lower shadow gradient, running parallel across the upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of approximately 10-15 high-luminance spots contained within the dark silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense pattern of varied-sized spots on the leading edge and surface of the large pectoral fin, transitioning from smaller clusters at the base to larger individuals toward the tip.
